description: Historical SQL captured before the materialized-distance/late-coordinate change. Used only for real-PostGIS result equivalence.

legacy.cursor:
WITH params AS (
      SELECT
        ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1, $2), 4326)::geography AS geog,
        COALESCE($9::timestamptz, now()) AS ranked_at,
        $10::double precision AS ranking_distance_scale,
        $11::double precision AS ranking_half_life,
        $12::double precision AS ranking_distance_weight,
        $13::double precision AS ranking_freshness_weight
    ), candidates AS (
      SELECT
        l.user_id,
        l.geom,
        ST_Distance(l.geom, p.geog) AS distance,
        l.updated_at,
        p.ranked_at
      FROM locations l
      CROSS JOIN params p
      WHERE ST_DWithin(l.geom, p.geog, $3)
        AND l.updated_at >= now()
         - make_interval(days => $7::int)
        AND ($8::text IS NULL OR l.user_id <> $8)
    ), ranked AS (
      SELECT
        user_id,
        geom,
        distance,
        updated_at,
        ranked_at,
        
  (
    1.0 / (distance + 1)
    + (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM updated_at) * 1000.0) / 1e10
  )::double precision
 AS score
      FROM candidates
    )
    SELECT
      user_id,
      ST_Y(geom::geometry) AS lat,
      ST_X(geom::geometry) AS lng,
      distance,
      updated_at,
      ranked_at,
      score,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked) AS total_count
    FROM ranked
    WHERE (
      $4::double precision IS NULL
      OR score < $4::double precision
      OR (score = $4::double precision AND user_id > $5::text)
    )
    ORDER BY score DESC, user_id ASC
    LIMIT $6

WITH params AS (
      SELECT
        ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1, $2), 4326)::geography AS geog,
        COALESCE($9::timestamptz, now()) AS ranked_at,
        $10::double precision AS ranking_distance_scale,
        $11::double precision AS ranking_half_life,
        $12::double precision AS ranking_distance_weight,
        $13::double precision AS ranking_freshness_weight
    ), candidates AS (
      SELECT
        l.user_id,
        l.geom,
        ST_Distance(l.geom, p.geog) AS distance,
        l.updated_at,
        p.ranked_at
      FROM locations l
      CROSS JOIN params p
      WHERE ST_DWithin(l.geom, p.geog, $3)
        AND l.updated_at >= p.ranked_at
         - make_interval(days => $7::int)
       AND l.updated_at <= p.ranked_at
        AND ($8::text IS NULL OR l.user_id <> $8)
    ), ranked AS (
      SELECT
        user_id,
        geom,
        distance,
        updated_at,
        ranked_at,
        
  (
    (
      $12::double precision
        * EXP(-distance / $10::double precision)
      + $13::double precision
        * POWER(
            0.5::double precision,
            GREATEST(
              EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
                ranked_at - updated_at
              ))::double precision,
              0.0
            ) / ($11::double precision * 60.0)
          )
    ) / NULLIF(
      $12::double precision
        + $13::double precision,
      0.0
    )
  )::double precision
 AS score
      FROM candidates
    )
    SELECT
      user_id,
      ST_Y(geom::geometry) AS lat,
      ST_X(geom::geometry) AS lng,
      distance,
      updated_at,
      ranked_at,
      score,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked) AS total_count
    FROM ranked
    WHERE (
      $4::double precision IS NULL
      OR score < $4::double precision
      OR (score = $4::double precision AND user_id > $5::text)
    )
    ORDER BY score DESC, user_id ASC
    LIMIT $6
